reviews.text:
There was a balance of gift certificates (card type) from the airline, and a female clerk with long black hair and glasses checked the balance. I asked if I could pay by combining this balance with cash, and I was told that was impossible, so I decided to pay in cash. The total was 12,700 won, which was over 20,700 won, but I couldn't even receive a receipt because I only got 3,000 won back from fishing. I left the Ashijoe store because the next customer was waiting, but when I thought about the situation carefully, I didn't know that there was money left in the gift certificate, so I stole 5,000 won. Never use this store twice! !

⭐︎Additional
Today, I received a confirmation from Busan GS to see if there was any balance left on the gift certificate, but there was still no balance left. It was revealed that 10,500 won was stolen.

A (very pretty and slim) female employee immediately informed me that it was a buy-one-get-one deal, and another male employee immediately handed me a Coke. Boss, please give your employees one more month’s salary and vacation. These people are really helpful to Korea's image :)
Sir, please consider what I say. If you don't believe me, check the CCTV footage and give me the prize. In my memories of Seoul, which is full of cold and selfish people, they will always remain like fragrant and fresh flowers.

reviews.author: Toon Tran
reviews.text:
GS25 Shindang Zenith Branch is a clean and spacious convenience store located at 13-1 Sindang-dong, Jung-gu, Seoul. Unlike some of the smaller downtown branches, this one offers plenty of space to shop without taking your breath away.

You can find a wide variety of products. From fresh meals and snacks to daily necessities and seasonal products, this is more like a mini-mart than a typical convenience store. Whether you're going out to buy gimbap late at night or are in a hurry to find a travel charger, the GS25 has it all covered.

The biggest attraction of this branch is its calm design and solid inventory. It's not because it's flashy, but it's a memorable GS25 that has everything right. It's perfect for both locals and travelers who value convenience and ample space.
